name: Butter Chicken & Roasted Poblano Quesadilla
cooking_method: Chill the reduced filling, build with cheese against both tortilla faces, griddle on a dry comal at medium heat with a light press, rest 1-2 min, cut

portion.description: 1 folded 25 cm quesadilla cut in 3 wedges + dip
portion.construction: cheese against both tortilla faces as a moisture barrier; filling in the centre; rajas against the cheese

steps: Marinate chicken in yogurt-spice 2 h at ≤ 5 °C; char hot (grill, broiler or comal), cook to 74 °C core, cool, dice about 1 cm.
Fold diced chicken into the reduced, fully chilled makhani sauce (35 g chicken + 25 g sauce is about 60 g filling).
On a tortilla: cheese across the surface, filling in the centre, rajas against the cheese, cheese again; fold.
Dry comal at medium heat, light press, until crisp and browned (about 2-3 min per side); rest 1-2 min; cut in 3 wedges; serve with raita-crema and lime.

plating: Three wedges stood up to show the cross-section (cheese fused, filling set, rajas visible), dip in a small cup, cilantro and a lime wedge. Surface a uniformly browned, blistered flour tortilla.
equipment: Blast chiller or shallow pans for chilling filling
food_safety: Poultry to 74 °C; separate raw-chicken board and hand-washing.
Cool cooked chicken and sauce rapidly and chill the filling before assembly (also a quality step).
Hot-hold finished quesadillas only briefly: they steam soft if covered.
Check cheese rennet source and tortilla for lard (D-54).

day_before: Marinate and char chicken, cool and dice
Make makhani sauce and rajas; chill filling mix
morning: Portion filling (60 g) and cheese (45 g)
service: Assemble, griddle 4-6 min total, rest, cut

cross_contact_precautions: MILK: separate utensils for dairy sauces and cheese where practical; clean fryer/comal surfaces between dairy and non-dairy items if a non-dairy request is ever offered; label check on all dairy ingredients.
WHEAT: flour dusting and dough areas are cross-contact sources; keep wheat flour away from rice-flour/cornflour coatings; separate scoops.
